description_en: Call DescribeDcdnDomainIspData to query daily statistics on carrier distribution for an accelerated domain name. You can query data from the last 90 days
description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDomainIspData查询加速域名天粒度的用户运营商分布数据统计，支持获取最近90天的数据
name: DescribeDcdnDomainIspData

parameters.help_en:
The accelerated domain name. You can query data for only a single domain name.

If you leave this parameter empty, data for all domain names that belong to your account is queried
parameters.help_zh:
加速域名，仅支持查询单个域名。

默认查询当前用户下所有域名
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 获取数据起始时间点。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据结束时间。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ。

结束时间需大于起始时间
parameters.name: end_time
